name: BONHOMME
based: No home base · travelling the world for 20 years
bio:
In the Cathar lands of southern France, people called the most devoted believers bonshommes: good men. BONHOMME carries that name into club culture: music made by hand, honestly, in service of art.

Genre doesn’t matter. What matters is that the music is good and the sound is perfect.
looking_for: Vocalists, MCs and producers in every port, for tracks in Estonian, English and any language you bring.
story: Twenty years on the road and at sea. Every place leaves its sound in the music.
